activity_summary: You said the weaver's going and coming again, bigger, as if the wall were the yard. You said the feet would give the plot away before dinner. You kept the bellows-mender's line off your tongue until it was written.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: attendee in Said the weaver's going and coming a second time

facets.activity: Tried the weaver's lines in a bigger voice

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Say it as if the wall were the yard.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The girl's line stays out of the mouth until it is on a leaf.
